text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina was injured, so I rushed her to 
the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer. However, I'm all 
right now."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Straight into training at this rate... 
—Ngh... !?
choice_data_list: No! You need to rest for now...!
No! You need to rest right now...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still...!! If I take time off to rest, 
I'll fall that much further behind...!!”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I can't let the others pull ahead of 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Standing at the "pinnacle," as a queen...!
choice_data_list:
If that injury gets worse, your little 
sisters will be heartbroken, you know?

...If I judge it to be dangerous, I'll 
stop it immediately.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Still, even so.........!
choice_data_list:
Overworking yourself doesn't set a good 
example, you know.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. If those kids were to 
imitate that, it would...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will take some rest for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In return, please adjust my training 
schedule so I can catch up once I make my 
comeback.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina rested quietly to focus entirely 
on treating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Staying attentively by her side, I have 
Verxina start with some light exercise. 
However..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list: That's enough! Let's call it off.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ……! Damn it……!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I was the one who brought 
it up... I am so sorry..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's injury healed slowly, and it 
took quite some time for her to recover.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Staying attentively by her side, I have 
Verxina start with some light exercise. 
Then—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. At this pace, I feel like I can 
keep going without overdoing it...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I won't yield to something like an 
injury. After all, I am the Queen—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina trained carefully within limits 
that wouldn't affect her injury, making a 
smooth recovery.
